run.name: Bally's Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (BALY)
run.summary: Bally's is a weak, stressed credit: debt is 9.57x Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA covers cash interest 1.15x, and the latest filing states substantial doubt about going concern. The outcome turns on unfinished financings and sponsor action. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt is principal of 4,910,068 thousand (Q2-26 10-Q page:37). Net debt deducts cash of 390,184 thousand. EBITDA is FY2025 combined plus six months 2026 less six months 2025 combined. Cash includes Bally’s Intralot cash; the parent and Intralot split is not supplied. Leases are excluded.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Same basis, FY2025 combined plus six months 2026 less six months 2025 combined (Q2-26 10-Q page:6, page:60). Cash interest excludes paid-in-kind interest of 9,518 thousand capitalized to debt in the six months and the 2026 term loan PIK option; it is net of capitalized interest.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash 390,184 thousand (Q2-26 10-Q page:2). Undrawn is 195.8 reported revolver availability (page:33) plus Bally’s Intralot revolver 95.0 million euros, about 108.5, calculated as 160.0 commitments less 65.0 drawn. Letters of credit under the Intralot revolver at this date are not printed. Intralot cash and facilities are not available to the parent group by guarantee: page:11 states that Bally’s Intralot does not guarantee any of Bally’s Corporation’s debt. Restricted cash of 97.6 is excluded.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant definitions, waiver terms and all events after August 14, 2026 are not supplied, so headroom and the October 2026 revolver reduction cannot be tested.
CP-1 main limitation: Last-twelve-month figures add split merger periods and count Intralot debt in full but its lottery and Turkey earnings only from October 2025; leases sit outside debt.
